summary: Enhance your marketing skills with our Fundamentals of Marketing Training Course. Learn essential strategies and techniques to boost your career today!
lede: Marketing fundamentals helps professionals who plan, deliver, or analyze customer-focused marketing connect market evidence to campaign choices and measurable results. The course covers market assessment, segmentation, targeting and positioning, buyer journeys, the 7Ps, campaign planning, and performance measurement. Participants practice selecting audiences, shaping value propositions, building campaign plans, and reporting campaign KPIs in a dashboard.
audienceIntro: This foundation-to-intermediate marketing fundamentals course is designed for professionals who plan, execute, analyze, or support customer-focused marketing work. It suits you if you need a structured method for connecting market evidence, campaign choices, and measurable results.
modules: Marketing Fundamentals with SWOT and PESTLE
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate marketing fundamentals course requires no formal qualification. You should bring a laptop with a modern web browser and spreadsheet access. Familiarity with your organization’s customers, products, or services will support the applied exercises. The course covers AI-assisted research, CRM workflows, and automated analytics at conceptual awareness and operational application levels. It does not require software development or technical engineering.
